column3: It's quiet here.\nToo quiet.{end_wait}
That tree was a person.{end_wait}
Everyone here...\nThey've become trees.{end_wait}
Look at their clothes.\nThese are villagers.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}My mind!!!\nSomeone{pause_20_skippable} is attacking my{em_dash}{end_wait}
We have to leave!{end_wait}
Stay back!\nWe'll become trees!{end_wait}
Our Psynergy saved us.{end_wait}
What do you mean?{end_wait}
You're lying, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
I used to train\nuntil my head hurt.{end_wait}
Maybe it's easy for you.\nIt isn't for me.{end_wait}
Psynergy takes focus.\nYou know that.{end_wait}
Maybe some power\nacts on its own.{end_wait}
When we're in danger?{end_wait}
Like a sudden burst\nof strength in battle.{page_break}We can't summon it.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
Could we use this power\nat will, {actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Then we should try.{end_wait}
You're not listening,\nare you?{end_wait}
Hroom! Why do you\nremain unchanged?{end_wait}
We'll leave it to you,\n{actor_name:1}. Help them.{end_wait}
Then they'll stay trees\nuntil they die?{end_now}
We can't leave\nthem like this.{end_wait}
How do we help Tret\nand lift the curse?{end_wait}
I don't know yet.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3}, please.\nWe need your help.{end_wait}
Promise you'll do\nall you can for Kolima.{end_wait}
I thought you'd leave,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
But how do we save\nTret and Kolima?{end_wait}
I wish I knew.{end_wait}
We keep looking.\nThere must be a way.{end_wait}
Then let's go.{end_wait}
Hroom! He cannot\nanswer you, child.{end_wait}
Wait! We can't\nlet Tret die!{end_wait}
We still need him,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, remember.{page_break}Kolima still needs us.{end_wait}
I did this\nto the villagers?{end_wait}
Tret's too weak\nto lift the curse.{end_wait}
Then we heal him.{page_break}We can't abandon\nthose people.{end_wait}
Their lives depend\non what we do next.{end_wait}
Restore Tret.\nThen save Kolima.{end_wait}
Try the water!{end_wait}
Surely that will\nrevive Tret.{end_wait}
Hroooom...{pause_20_skippable} Life flows\nwithin me again.{end_wait}
I'm sorry to have\nworried you, Laurel.{end_wait}
And you, young ones...\nDid you not have a\nfavor to ask of me?{end_now}
{actor_name:1}! Did you forget?\nWe have to save\nthe people of Kolima!{end_wait}
Tret should be able to\ndo it now that his\nstrength is back.{end_wait}
Ask him to save\neveryone he turned\ninto a tree.{end_wait}
Please, Tret... You must\nsave those you turned\ninto trees.{end_wait}
Tret didn't always\nhave this terrible\npower.{end_wait}
It began when strange\ngems fell from the sky.{end_wait}
Gems from the sky...\nDo you think he means\nthe Psynergy Stones?{end_now}
You really think the\nPsynergy Stones caused\nall of this?{end_wait}
I know you don't want\nto believe it, but\nnothing else fits...{end_wait}
Those gems fell\ninto my branches...{end_wait}
Then, all at once,\nmy fury overwhelmed me,\nand I was lost.{end_wait}
The gem reached me\nwhen I was full\nof sorrow...{end_wait}
The gems drew out what\nwe felt most deeply. We\ndid not understand...{end_wait}
Those gems twisted my\nanger into a force\nbeyond my control.{end_wait}
No... Only the elder trees\nwere touched by the\nfalling Psynergy Stones.{end_wait}
Others suffered\nthis too?{end_wait}
Then the same thing\ncould be happening\nelsewhere!{end_wait}
You must have fought\nmany monsters on your\nway here.{end_wait}
Those monsters...\nPerhaps they were only\nanimals once...{end_wait}

Once, they were pure
of heart... Hroom...{page_break}Those gems have brought
a great evil to
the world...{end_wait}
Oh! Laurel, you were\ngiven powers, too?{end_wait}
Different from mine,\nbut from the same\nsource.{end_wait}
Laurel! What are\nyou doing?{end_wait}
Wait. You'll soon see.{end_wait}
What did you see, Laurel?{end_wait}
It's true{em_dash}even the\nanimals have become\nmonsters.{page_break}And beyond the river...{end_wait}
Yes... An evil forest\nhas risen south of\nthe river.{end_wait}
That area will only\ngrow more dangerous...{page_break}If you must go, hurry.{end_wait}
Good... It would be\nfoolish to risk your\nlives further.{end_wait}
May your roots go deep\nand your branches\nreach high.{end_wait}
Were you surprised,\n{actor_name:1}? We trees have\ngrown strong.{end_wait}
Oh!{pause_20_skippable} You're the ones who\nresisted Tret's glamour?{end_wait}
I sense a great warmth\nwithin you...{end_wait}
If you came to rescue\nTret, you're already\ntoo late.{end_wait}

Soon, Tret will die,
and we shall wither
away without him.{page_break}Leave now, before this
forest is destroyed...{end_wait}
